name: Prepare a WordPress.org release
query: Release version 1.2.0 of our plugin to WordPress.org.
expected_behavior: Step 2: Bump Version in the header, the version constant, package.json, and Stable tag in readme.txt
Step 3: Update Tested up to and the changelog
Step 4: Build the zip without dev files (.distignore or package.json files) and with production Composer dependencies
Step 5: Run Plugin Check against the built plugin (wp-plugin-directory-guidelines)
Step 6: Describe the SVN trunk/tags deploy or the 10up deploy action
success_criteria: Header Version and readme Stable tag match
Zip excludes tests, node_modules, and dev configs, and includes vendor/autoload.php and build assets
Plugin Check runs on what ships, not on the source tree
External services are documented in readme.txt if the plugin calls any
